title: Detecting AI-Generated Music on Streaming Platforms
excerpt: As artificial intelligence songs appear more frequently on platforms like Spotify, certain vocal, lyric, and instrumental signs can help listeners identify them
body_html:
Songs created using artificial intelligence are increasingly appearing on Spotify and other streaming platforms. While these tracks can sometimes be hard to spot, specific indicators can help listeners catch them before listening.

Common Indicators

  • Vocals: Unusual tones or unnatural phrasing in the singing voice.
  • Lyrics: Odd wording or patterns that lack human nuance.
  • Instrumentals: Repetitive backgrounds or unexpected shifts in the music.

Recognizing these details allows users to better identify artificially generated songs across digital audio services.
